item.title: Fileless ELF Execution via Kernel Keyring
item.description: Using the Linux kernel keyring to stage an ELF in slab memory and execute it via userland exec, skipping execve and the filesystem entirely.

item.title: Fileless ELF Execution via O_TMPFILE
item.description: O_TMPFILE creates anonymous inodes on real filesystems with no directory entry. Combine it with execveat(AT_EMPTY_PATH) and you get fileless ELF execution that looks nothing like memfd_create in telemetry.

item.title: Singularity Rootkit: Evading Elastic Defend Module Load Detection
item.description: Elastic Defend 9.5 added taint_flags to the module_load BPF event and a new detection rule on top of it. Here is how Singularity loads clean: source obfuscation for YARA, trusted_pids insertion for the BPF hook, and OBF_OUT=/var/lib/dkms for the .ko creation rule.

item.title: BPF Map Poisoning: Attacking Falco from the Inside
item.description: Rewriting Falco's BPF map state from userspace to suppress syscall monitoring without touching the eBPF program.

item.title: Red Team Tactics: Evading EDR on Linux with io_uring
item.description: Learn how to bypass modern defenses with io_uring
